label: Tokenizer (Search)
type: the analyzer component splitting input strings into individual tokens - exactly one per analyzer, unlike character/token filters which are zero-or-more. Two custom kinds: regexp (isSubtypeOf) and exception (which itself wraps another tokenizer for the remaining input, a recursive composition).
evidence: Tokenizers control how the Search Service splits input strings into individual tokens.
